university: Asia Pacific University of Technology & Innovation
program_name: Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Hospitality and Tourism with a specialism in Hospitality Innovation

requirements.general_text: For Direct Entry into Year 1 STPM: Minimum 2 passes with Grade C (GP 2.0) A-Levels: Minimum 2 passes (Grades A–D) UEC: Minimum 5 Grade Bs Matriculation/Foundation: Pass with a minimum CGPA of 2.0 For Direct Entry into Year 2 Diploma: Successful completion of APU Diploma, or Completion of a Diploma from a recognised institution with academic credits equivalent to Year 1 of an Honours Degree (subject to APU Academic Board approval) English Language Requirements IELTS: Band 5.0 MUET: Band 3.5
